name: reachinbox-email-scheduler
description: Email scheduler with BullMQ, Postgres and a React dashboard (ReachInbox assignment)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
